whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Yoga Classes Patna,

I noticed your studio has an exceptional 4.9★ rating with 41+ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new student inquiries.

Maine aapke yoga studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp batch booking, morning/evening timings, aur class schedule integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://yoga-classes-patna-demo.web.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Yoga Classes Patna, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp batch booking and mobile-first speed for Kankarbagh students. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact class timings aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
